1.

Smitten, wounded, and despised, Christ died on the tree of the cross. Behold, how by a world rejected, There He suffered, God’s precious Lamb! Behold, the offering God Himself chose To endure His wrath’s judgment! He is the Word and God’s Anointed, The Son of Man, yea also God’s Son.

2.

Here we have a foundation sure, Here a refuge in all sorrow. Christ is our salvation’s Rock, And His name our stronghold. O Lamb of God, for sins wounded, The offering that takes all guilt away, None shall be disappointed, Who now has His hope in Thee.
